name: go2_turn
title: Go2 turn-in-place (SHADOWING: certified differential-stride turn ghost + certified champion)
summary: The missing third specialist of the quadruped BATON story: a Go2 turning in place by SHADOWING a certified turn ghost. The reference is the trot gait model's own yaw-rate steering (tangential stance sweep, self-tested reachable) at vx=0 -- outer and inner legs sweep equal-magnitude OPPOSITE strides, which is the textbook differential-stride turn. Commanded 0.8 rad/s; the plant ACHIEVES 0.5895 rad/s (33.8 deg/s) open-loop under the bare deploy PD, inside the conservative 30-45 deg/s design band. STATUS: VERIFIED 2026-07-17. The ladder: 95.5% (zero-hook) -> 97.5% (+400 iters) -> 99.2% (WZ_FIXED cert arm, >= the 99% bar, vx -0.003 = true turn-in-place), and the live BATON walk->turn->walk exam ran the same evening: 3/3 headless, zero falls, ~169 deg turn-in-place, both 'ONNX loaded:' asserted. Free-standing -- quads carry no harness.

ghost.format: json lut (nb=64 bins, 12 joints, freq 1.8 Hz, vx~0, wz=0.8 cmd / wz_meas=0.5895 achieved)
ghost.provenance: recorded/achieved (doctrine class 1a via the ANALYTIC source): the go2_trot_gait model at vx=0, wz=0.8 rad/s executed OPEN-LOOP and deterministically through the bare deploy-grade PD on the deploy-matched MJCF dump (go2_newton.xml, kp=250, 16 ms x 8 substeps), steady segment (t>=3 s, 16.2 cycles) phase-folded at 64 bins and harmonic-smoothed. The folded track is the plant's ACHIEVED response, not the reference -- no turn champion exists to record, and the walk champion has never seen a non-zero wz command, so the builder refuses --wz with --source champion.
ghost.validator: PASS (stamped into the lut, 2026-07-17: all 9 gates ok against the REAL go2.urdf; T0.leg-symmetry is turn-aware -- a lut that declares wz!=0 is L/R-antisymmetric BY DESIGN, the mirror of a +wz turn is a -wz turn, and only the amp-ratio balance is still checked, 0.86 vs the 0.6 floor). Builder gates in the lut's `gates` key: lut_replay (bare deploy PD tracks the folded lut: steady wz +0.441 of source +0.439 rad/s at wz=0.6 probe / +0.592 of +0.590 at the shipped 0.8, closure drift p95 14.0 mm vs the 20 mm gate, peak torque 40%, no fall), construction_reroll (peak torque 59%, saturated 0/750, no fall), support_fwp_certificate_replay (PASS, base_frac95 0.0).
ghost.corridor_law: ghost peak |cmd - q| = 0.111 rad at kp=250 -- UNDER the 0.15 corridor, so unlike the walk ghost (0.217) this reference is trackable by the corridor even without feedforward. GHOST_FF=1 is still declared and used for parity with the walk skill (same decode on both BATON legs) and to keep the residual budget for corrections.

policy.checkpoint_status: CERTIFIED 2026-07-17: WZ_FIXED cert arm (seed 2, warm from the zero-hook lineage), in-engine eval never_fell 99.2% (>= 99% bar), vx -0.003 m/s (true turn-in-place). Live BATON exam PASSED the same day: walk:10,turn:5,walk:10 ran 3/3 with ZERO falls -- turn leg holds position (x drift ~0.01m, y ~0.15m < 0.3m bar) and produces a ~169 deg heading change (5s at the lut's wz_meas 0.5895 rad/s; evidenced by the third leg walking BACK along -x at ~0.4 m/s). Runs are deterministic (identical traces). Logs: _scratch/wtw_run6.log, wtw_verify_r2/r3.log.

train.env: QUAD_ROBOT=go2 QUAD_GHOST=projects/policies/ghosts/go2/go2_turn_ghost_lut.json QUAD_GHOST_FF=1 QUAD_W_GMATCH=2.0 QUAD_RES_SCALE=0.15 QUAD_VX_TARGET=0.0 QUAD_YAW=0.0 QUAD_ENVS=16384 QUAD_FAST_RESET=1 MPC_NJMAX=64 MPC_NCONMAX=64 QUAD_ITERS=400 QUAD_WARMSTART=projects/policies/research/inference/policies/gpu_go2_shadow_r2_main/policy.pt RES_POLICY=projects/policies/research/inference/policies/gpu_go2_turn_main/policy.pt
train.notes: PRIMARY PLAN IS ZERO-HOOK (see TRAIN_PLAN.md in this dir): every knob above EXISTS in quad_walk_recipe.py today. QUAD_YAW=0.0 is REQUIRED, not cosmetic -- the default -0.5 penalises |wz - wz_cmd| with wz_cmd=0, i.e. it would actively fight the turn the ghost commands. QUAD_VX_TARGET=0 makes the velocity reward pull vx to 0 (turn-IN-PLACE); QUAD_LAT already penalises drift; the turn itself is carried by the corridor centre (the turn lut) + QUAD_W_GMATCH. UPGRADE plan (only if the primary under-rotates): the QUAD_WZ_FIXED recipe hook + QUAD_YAW=-1.0, spec'd verbatim in TRAIN_PLAN.md. Ghost mode is opt-in, so legacy training stays byte-identical.
